choice.label: a choice among options
choice.means: Answered by picking one of the options listed with the question.

value.label: a value
value.means: Answered with one value, such as a time, a number or a name.

parts.label: several parts
parts.means: Several sub-points asked together; each part gets its own answer.

do-then-say.label: do something, then say
do-then-say.means: The person does something first, such as trying a build, and then says the word.
